name: Lady Nifle
bio: A ghostly matriarch who wields a life-draining scythe. A hybrid burst DPS, alternating between Solar Eclipse for Lumino damage and Lunar Hunt for Umbro damage, with wide-range skills that can narrow to a powerful single-target hit.

skills.name: Solar Eclipse
skills.desc: Summons [Solar Eclipse] and replaces this skill with [Lunar Hunt]. [Solar Eclipse]: Deals Lumino Damage to all enemies within range when summoned and reduces their Attack.

skills.name: Misty Sea Requiem
skills.desc: Enters [Funeral Rite] state. If Lady Nifle's Skill Range exceeds 100%, converts the excess portion into Skill Damage at a certain percentage, and the Skill Range will be reduced to and remain at 100% until the [Funeral Rite] state ends. While in [Funeral Rite] state: Increases Lady Nifle's Ranged Weapon Trigger Probability; Does not consume Sanity when summoning [Solar Eclipse] and increases the damage dealt by [Solar Eclipse]; Does not consume Sanity when summoning [Lunar Hunt] and pulls all targets on hit towards the center. The [Funeral Rite] state ends after a certain period of time or after summoning [Lunar Hunt] and [Solar Eclipse] 6 times.

skills.name: Interwoven Cries
skills.desc: Based on Lady Nifle's Ranged Weapon Trigger Probability, there is a chance to summon 1 additional [Lunar Hunt] when summoning [Solar Eclipse] at the same location, and vice versa. The additional summoned [Solar Eclipse] and [Lunar Hunt] will not be enhanced by [Misty Sea Requiem].

skills.name: Nightfall
skills.desc: [Solar Eclipse] can trigger "Bonus Effects: Lumino," while [Lunar Hunt] can trigger "Bonus Effects: Umbro."

skills.name: Crimson Radiance
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Lumino teammate(s).
